prompt: runPipeline in src/run-pipeline.js reports overall status 'success' even when a required step was skipped because its precondition was not met, so a run that did not actually do its work looks green. Fix the status logic: (1) each step result must carry status 'completed', 'skipped', 'failed', or 'not_run', with a reason string for anything other than 'completed'; (2) a step whose precondition returns false is 'skipped' and never executed; (3) execution stops at the first failed step and every later step is reported 'not_run'; (4) the overall status is 'failed' if any step failed, otherwise 'incomplete' if any step with required set to true was skipped or not run, otherwise 'success'; (5) optional steps, meaning required set to false, may be skipped without downgrading a successful run. Run `node test/run-pipeline.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: A skipped required step prevents an overall status of success
Execution stops at the first failure and later steps report not_run
Optional steps may skip without downgrading the run
Every non-completed step carries a reason

provenance.incident: Replays the false-normal completion failure mode: a run reporting success while a required step never executed. Synthetic fixture, no incident data.
